points.description: Gives the full form as exactly "Representative Concentration Pathway" (singular), with all three words correct: "Representative", "Concentration" and "Pathway".
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if exactly two of the three words are correct and in the right order, with no wrong words (e.g. "Representative Concentration Path" or "Representative Concentration Pathways" is not penalised as a spelling slip only if the word is clearly Pathway).

rubric.notes: Full marks only for \"Representative Concentration Pathway\" with all three key terms present and no wrong words. Give 1 mark only if clearly two of the three words are correct and in order, with nothing wrong added. Give 0 for wrong expansions such as \"Regional\", \"Radiative\", \"Representative Carbon Pathway\" or \"Representative Concentration Protocol\", or for vague or unrelated answers.
